pages.text: Sunshine filled the morning. Today they were washing all the family's bedding and blankets.
Lulu hugged a blanket. "I will hang up my own."
Aunt Rosa waved by the clothesline. "The sunniest spot is here!"
As soon as Lulu hung the blanket, she moved it. "No, the breeze is better there!"
Each move from line to line made the clotheslines sway.
Sway! The bedding beside it slid together to one side.
Aunt Rosa grabbed for it. Laundry filled both her arms.
Lulu went to a low line at the yard corner. Just the right height.
Lulu hung the blanket and fastened wooden pegs tight. Even the wind could not move it.
Lulu's blanket danced in the sunshine. Only Aunt Rosa's face peeked out of the laundry pile.
